caseName: Mom's Book Club Is Two Hours North
title: Callum & Lorraine

questions.text:
Thanks for helping me with this.
She's on her phone constantly now, smiling at the screen. Once I caught a little heart next to his name. 😤
Who is the man she keeps texting?

Never heard her mention him. Not once.
Every week she tells me she's off to book club. Mom hasn't finished a book since Dad died. 🙄
Which city does she actually drive to?

Two and a half hours each way. For a book club.
She used to pay for everything with a card. Now she always seems to have cash on her.
How much cash has she taken out over the past 30 days?

That's a lot of money for paperbacks.
I called her twice on her last book club night. Nothing until the next morning. She said she was tired. 😤
Where exactly does she stay overnight up there?
questions.hint: Look through her Messages, then her recent places in Maps.

questions.text:
A motel. With Hal somewhere up there. Great.
I keep telling myself there's a boring explanation. Mom is the most boring person I know.
So what kind of place is this "book club" of hers, really?
questions.hint: Check saved places in Maps, then Safari.

questions.text:
A memory clinic. That has to be a mistake.
Mom's the sharpest person I know. She still corrects my spelling when I text her.
Maybe that's where Hal found her. What's Hal's last name?
questions.hint: Search her Mail, then compare with Messages.

questions.text:
A neurologist. My stomach just dropped.
I refer patients to neuro all the time. Weekly visits that far away usually mean a research program, not regular care.
What's the name of the program she's in?

onboarding.text: I'm Callum. Physical therapist. I spend my days telling people their pain is real and their recovery is up to them. I'm good at reading bodies. Apparently I'm terrible at reading my own mother.
onboarding.label: Callum

onboarding.text: That's Mom. Lorraine. School librarian, sixty-one, widowed six years. After Dad died she stopped reading, stopped going out, stopped everything. Then this summer she suddenly got busy. Too busy.
onboarding.label: Lorraine

onboarding.text: She leaves town every week. She's pulling out cash. And she texts some man with a little heart next to his name. I've read the stories. Lonely widows, smooth strangers, savings gone.
onboarding.label: Callum & Lorraine

onboarding.text: She cracked her screen and asked me to drop the phone off for repair. I have it for one afternoon. Help me figure out who this guy is, and how much he's already taken.
onboarding.label: Callum

You're my hero.

Understood. I'm only coming in a couple mornings a week for inventory.

That's fine. Thanks for asking them
Greg is doing the network upgrade next week. Library computers will be down.
Good to know. I'll move my days around.
He says he'll label the cables this time. I'll believe it when I see it.
Hi Lorraine, the district sent the new badge policy. Everyone needs updated ID photos in the fall.
Ugh, my last one looks like a hostage photo. Do I get a retake?
One retake. Choose wisely. 📸
Have a wonderful summer! Come visit us 💛
You too! I'll bring cookies in August
New substitute list came in. Jen Hartley is on it for library coverage.
Wonderful, she's great with the kids.
The boiler inspector is coming tomorrow morning. Office will be locked. Do you need anything from your desk?
My reading glasses, black case, second drawer.
Found them. I'll leave them in the mail slot.
Bless you.
Your supply order came in. Forty reams of paper and a box of laminating sheets.
Laminating sheets! The good stuff. I'll grab them tomorrow.

Afternoon is fine. Fewer sleepy kids, honestly.
You say that now.
Office is closed for the holiday week. I'll check email only.
Enjoy the break, Denise.
A parent asked if the summer reading list is on the website yet.
I'll upload it tomorrow. Sorry, it slipped.
No rush. Just pass it along when it's done.

Works! Thank you.
Staff directory update: please confirm your cell number is still the same.
Same one, yes.

I'll be there. Bringing lemon bars by popular demand?
Bring two pans.

Let me think about it, thanks

Perfect.
Reminder: inspection visit this morning between eight and ten.

Inspection done. Tank is showing rust at the base. Recommend replacement within the year. Quote to follow.
Rust? Should I be worried?
Not an emergency. No leaks. Just plan ahead.
OK. Send the quote when you can.
Thanks. Our tech Dale is on his way and will arrive in about 20 minutes.

Quote sent to your email: forty-gallon unit, installed, $1,480.
That's more than I expected. Let me think it over and talk to my son.
No pressure. The quote is good for ninety days.
Thank you. Quick question, should I be worried about the slow drain in the basement?
Probably just a clog. Try a drain snake first. Call us if it gets worse.
Hi Lorraine, checking in on the water heater quote. We have an opening next week.
Let's do it. Can you come the morning of June 24?
June 24 works. Arrival window is eight to ten.
See you then.

Cleared. Door's unlocked, I'm in the kitchen.
Tech has arrived. Estimated two hours to finish.
Install complete. New forty-gallon unit, ten-year tank warranty. Paperwork on the way.
Hot water already. Thank you, they were tidy and kind.
Wonderful. An annual flush is recommended to keep the warranty happy.
How did we do? Rate your visit from one to ten.
Ten. Obviously.
Thank you! A review helps small businesses like ours.
I'll leave one on the map listing tonight.
Summer special: free outdoor spigot inspection with any service call. Reply to book.
I do have one outdoor spigot that drips.
Want us to look at it?
Yes, but not until mid-August, I'm travelling.
No problem. Reply when you're ready and we'll schedule.
Ready to schedule. Any morning after the middle of August is fine.
Morning! Still on for the farmers market at ten? I'll grab us a spot near the flower stall.
Yes! I'm bringing my own bags this time. Last time I felt like a walking grocery cart.
Wear walking shoes, the lot is a mess from the construction.
Noted. See you at ten.
That rhubarb pie was a mistake. A delicious mistake.
I told you to split one. You bought two.
One was for the neighbors. Allegedly.
Do you remember the name of that restaurant on Grand with the great soup?
Bridgeman's? No wait, that's ice cream. Let me think
Ha. It'll come to me at 3 am
Mickey's Dining Car?
NO, it was Cafe Latte! Thanks 😆
Cafe Latte, of course. Their turtle cake!
Did you see the lilacs on the corner of Xerxes? Already gone. Spring is so short here.
Every year I say I'll enjoy them more and every year I blink.
My daughter is bringing the twins up for Memorial Day weekend. Send help.
How old are they now, four?
Four going on forty.
Best age. Bring them by the school garden bed if you need to wear them out. Gail won't mind in summer.
Book recommendation please. Something light. My brain is mush after the twins.
Try the Richard Osman. Cozy mystery, retirement home, very funny.
Adding to my hold list.
Hennepin has plenty of copies, you'll get it fast.
Did you see the neighborhood association email? They want to repaint the little free library.
I did! I volunteered to restock it. Someone keeps leaving cookbooks from the 70s.
Those are collector's items now. 😂
Got the Osman. Stayed up till one in the morning. Ugh, thank you.
That's the highest compliment a librarian can get.
Heirloom tomatoes at the market finally. Going this morning, want anything?
Two pounds if they have the striped ones. I'll Venmo you.
Don't be silly, you can buy the coffee.
Got the striped ones. Also a ridiculous hat.
Of course you did.
Lunch there soon?
I'd love that. School's out, so I'm flexible. Mostly
Mostly?
Errands and appointments. You know how it goes at our age
Paint day is next weekend. Bring a brush and an old shirt.
I'll be there if I'm in town. Save me a corner.
Heat advisory tomorrow. Come sit in my basement and read, it's like a cave.
I may take you up on that. My kitchen is an oven.
It's finished and it's a lovely blue. Come see it!
Just walked by. It looks great, thank you for organizing.
Fourth of July plans? Lakes parade or hide indoors?
Hide indoors, I think. Too many people, too loud.
Honestly same. I'll bring lemonade and a fan.
The fireworks sound like the building is being demolished. Poor dogs in the neighborhood.
Biscuit is under my bed. Both of us are shaking.
The twins lost a tooth. One of them. Both are claiming credit.
Tooth fairy rates are up, I hear.
Tell me about it. Four dollars? Highway robbery.
Walk around Lake Harriet tomorrow morning? Before the heat.
Yes, meet at the bandshell at eight?
Eight. Bring the good water bottle.
Block party planning meeting is soon. I'll send details.
That was lovely. My knees are filing a complaint though.
Coffee next week? I owe you a debrief on the twins' sleepover.
Yes, I'd love that. Text me a day that works.

Summer reading. Maybe something silly
Then it's Click, Clack, Moo
Perfect 😊

Thank you, Gail

Pizza AND no students. Perfect

Gail, you're a hero. Thank you
Don't thank me yet, you have to present the weeding plan
Ugh. Fine. I'll bring pie charts
Lorraine, quick question: can the library host the fall orientation tour for the new sixth graders?
Happy to. I'll draft a scavenger hunt so they don't just stare at their shoes.
You're the best. Budget approved for new beanbags too. 🎉
Hope summer's treating you well. Don't forget to turn in your inventory report before July
Almost done. I'll send it this week
Thanks!
Enjoy your summer, you've earned it!
Lorraine, the district wants the library inventory report before the fall. Any chance you can send it by the end of July?
Absolutely. I'll have Marcy help me count the nonfiction
You two are a dream. Thank you
Do you still plan to take your usual days off in the fall? I'm building the coverage schedule.
Probably. I'll confirm with you by the end of the month.
No rush. Jen Hartley can sub for you again if needed.
Got the inventory, thank you. Impeccable as always
New schedule for fall is attached to my email. Library is open first period every day
Got it. That works for me
The new shelving was delivered to the school. Greg says it's a puzzle of a thousand screws.
I'll stop in tomorrow and help sort it out.
Quick one: the new fall schedule's posted. Library is open all periods again 🎉
Wonderful news. Thank you for fighting for it
You're the reason it matters
Are you able to run the August orientation table for new sixth graders?
Yes, I'll plan a scavenger hunt in the stacks
Sixth graders and a scavenger hunt. Wear comfortable shoes 😄
Always do
Lorraine! Mom says you're hosting the cousins again this summer?? Is that true or is she volunteering you
Ha. She's volunteering me. But I did say I'd think about it
Think fast, the cabin at Lake Mille Lacs is booked for the last weekend of July and I need headcount
Oh, the cabin! Then I'm in. Put me down for me and Cal. Maybe Cal. He's always working
That boy needs a vacation more than anyone
I'll bring the wild rice hotdish
YES. Last time Uncle Gene went back for thirds and then denied it
He had a plate hidden behind the toaster 😂
Found Grandma's quilt in my attic. The blue and yellow one. Do you want it or should I give it to Aunt Carol
Oh Barb. Keep it for now, I'll come see it. I'd just worry about spilling tea on it
Deal. Come for coffee, I'll make the lemon bars
Sorry I've been scarce. Busy few weeks with school winding down
No need to apologize! Brent's knee surgery is next week so I'm a nurse now. God help us
Tell him I'll send a casserole
Don't you dare, we have four already. Send gossip instead
Okay. Gossip: Wendy from book club is dyeing her hair purple
NO. At her age? Good for her honestly
Brent is home and cranky. The physical therapist is coming tomorrow, thank goodness. Cal does that for a living, right?
He does. He'd tell Brent to stop skipping his exercises
He'd be right too 🙄
Mom wants to know if you're coming to the reunion in August
Where is it this year?
Lake Minnetonka, the park pavilion. Same potluck chaos
I'll make the jello salad nobody eats 😄
Everyone eats it. Uncle Pete has three helpings
Lorraine! Family reunion is set for next month at Aunt Carol's lake place. Can you bring the potato salad?
Of course. Dan's mother's recipe, so nobody argue with it.
Ha! No arguments. The kids are bringing the lawn games.
Photo of the cabin dock from last year, to get you excited
Lovely. I can already smell the lake
Do you still have Dan's old canoe paddles? The kids want to try the little canoe
They're in the garage. I'll dig them out. Dan would love that
He would. Miss him at these things
Me too, honey
How's Carol's recovery plan looking? I told her I could help
I've got the first week. Maybe you could take the second?
Let me look at my calendar and tell you
No pressure!
Is Callum coming? Haven't seen him since the holidays.
I'll ask him. He works a lot of weekends.
Tell him I'll make the bars he likes.
Final headcount is 19. Is Cal coming or not? Gene needs to know about the bunks
I'll ask him. Put a question mark next to us for now
Fine. Question marks cost nothing 😂
Photo of the old farm I found in Mom's boxes, remember it? 🐄
Lorraine, I'm so sorry, Brent caught a bug and we have to cancel the cabin weekend. Rebooking for September
Oh no. Poor Brent. September works fine for me, the leaves will be pretty
Thank you for being easy. Mom was ready to riot
Tell Brent to drink fluids and stop watching the news
Will do. Love you cuz ❤️
Reunion photos are up in the family album! You look wonderful, Lorraine.
Thanks Barb. It was a good day. 💙
Lorraine, it's Janice. Choir practice moved to the fellowship hall this week, the sanctuary floor is being refinished
Thanks for the heads up! Same time?
Same time. Bring your own folding chair, they're short
Of course they are 😄
Did you watch that British baking show last night? I cried over a sourdough
I fell asleep at the bread round. Tell me who went home
The nice one with the glasses. Unjust
Are you coming to the garden walk? Tickets are $12 at the door
I'd love to but I have a standing appointment on some days now. Let me check and get back to you
You and your appointments lately! Everything okay?
Just boring stuff. Getting older is a part-time job
Ain't that the truth. My hip has opinions about the stairs
Are we still on for coffee at Birchwood?
Yes! 9 works for me
Perfect. I'll grab the corner table
That was fun. We should do it more often
Agreed. Thanks for listening to me ramble
Can you pick up altos music from the church office? I'm stuck at the dentist
Sure, heading there anyway
You're a saint. I owe you a coffee
Got the music. There's a folder with your name and a coffee ring on it
That's the pastor's coffee ring, not mine. I have standards
Memorial Day potluck at the church. Sign up sheet says you're on desserts again
Rhubarb crisp. I have a lot of rhubarb
Rhubarb is the only thing in Minnesota that grows without being asked
Did you see the new exhibit at the Walker?
Not yet. Is it good?
Weird but good. Want to go together?
Let me get back to you, my schedule is a mess these weeks
No rush 😊
Walk this morning? The weather is perfect before the heat kicks in.
Yes! Meet at the lake path at 7?
Perfect. I'll bring coffee in the big thermos.
Saw you weren't at choir last night. Are you alright?
I'm fine, just tired. I'll be there next time, promise
Okay. We missed your alto, the sopranos went flat without you 😉
Flattery gets you rhubarb
Did you hear the bakery on Lake Street is closing? Say it isn't so.
No! Where will I buy my guilty-pleasure scones?
We'll have to learn to bake. Terrifying.
Summer break for choir starts after the 4th. Dinner at that Thai place to celebrate?
That sounds nice. I'll check my calendar
You always say that and then you cancel 🙃
I know. I'm sorry. Let's really do it, my treat
Thai place, 7 o'clock, I made the reservation
Perfect. I'll be there
That pad see ew was worth the wait. Thank you for coming ❤️
Thank you for making me. It was a lovely night
Free tonight? My daughter sent me a new show to binge.
Rain check? Long day. Call you tomorrow.
Lorraine! Linda Ostrow. I'm back from my sister's in Sarasota. Coffee soon?
Linda! Welcome home. Yes please. Birchwood Cafe?
Their blueberry muffins, yes. Next week?
Next week works. Ten o'clock
Ten it is. I'll wear my floppy hat so you can find me
I'd find you anyway, you're the one talking over the espresso machine 😄
Rude and accurate
Great seeing you today. You look thin, are you eating?
Lots of muffins, Linda. You saw me eat two
Fair. I worry. Old teacher habit
Photo of my granddaughter's recital! She was a tree
A magnificent tree. Best in show
She had one line and she delivered it to the wrong side of the stage
Trees don't take direction. It's method acting
Retirement is wonderful. I forgot what day it was and nobody cared
I'm jealous. Three more years for me, maybe
Don't wait too long. Take it from me
I know. I've been thinking about that more lately
Are you retiring in a year or two? I keep telling people you should enjoy it while you can
I'm starting to think you're right. Maybe sooner than I planned
Really? You loved that library more than anyone I know
I still do. Let's talk over muffins
I had my hip replacement scheduled for the 18th of June. Nervous!
You'll be walking marathons by fall. I'll bring soup
Cal is a physical therapist right? Any tips?
He says do every exercise even when you hate it. And no skipping, he's very firm about that
Yes ma'am. Tell him I said thank you
Lorraine! Retired life update: I have learned to make sourdough. It is a rock.
Ha! Mine is a very flat rock. We should start a club.
Are you coming to the retired teachers lunch next month?
I'm not retired yet, am I invited?
You're an honorary member. Bring your appetite
Then I'll be there 😊
Lunch soon? I'm dying to hear how the new principal is doing.
Gail's wonderful. Same school, same sticky floors.
Some things never change. Lunch at the Birchwood?
Yes. Let me look at my week and get back to you.
Surgery went well. I'm in a bed with a jello cup and opinions
So glad! I'll visit with soup in a few days
Thank you for the chicken noodle. My daughter ate half 😂
That's what soup is for
Do you still have that recipe for the cranberry bread?
Will dig it out and send a photo of the card tonight
Birchwood was lovely. Same time next month?
Absolutely. Thanks for the company. 😊
Walked to the mailbox and back today. Cried a little. Good tears
Proud of you, Linda. Keep going
Muffins when I can drive again. You're buying

Thank you, I'll come by after school

YES
Great! We have an opening tomorrow at 9:00 AM. Reply C to confirm.
C

Nordic Auto Care: Your oil change is due. Book online or reply to this text.
Do you have anything open next week?

8 AM please
Nordic Auto Care: Booked. See you then.
Nordic Auto Care: Your Subaru is ready. Total $78.40. Also, your rear tires are getting low.
How low? Do I need them right away?
Nordic Auto Care: Within a couple months is fine. We can quote a set anytime.
Hi Lorraine, your car is overdue for a tire rotation. Summer special: $19.99 through the end of June.
Can I book one for the end of the month?
Absolutely. How's the last week of June, morning?
Perfect
Nordic Auto Care: Your oil change is due. Book online or reply BOOK.
BOOK

1 PM please.

Your car is ready. Oil changed, tires rotated. Total was $79.40. Thanks, Lorraine!
Nordic Auto Care: Tire special this month, buy 3 get 1 half off.
Thanks, I'll think about it
Nordic Auto Care: Your Subaru is due for an oil change. Book online or reply BOOK.
BOOK. Do you have anything next week?

Perfect, thank you
Confirmed for tomorrow morning at 8:30. See you then!
All done! Your car is ready. Tires look great, but your wiper blades are worn. Want us to replace them next time?
Yes next time. Thank you!
Your car is ready. Oil change and tire rotation done. Total $89.40. We noticed your brake pads are getting thin, ask us about it next visit.
Thanks! I'll schedule the brakes in the fall
Nordic Auto Care: Summer special, free A/C check with any service this month.
Nordic Auto Care: Please take a minute to rate your recent visit. We appreciate your feedback.
Pick you up at 5:30 tomorrow. Bring the good thermos.
Packed already. Cal thinks I'm off to book club, God forgive me 🙈
God has bigger things to forgive me for. Go to bed early.
Home safe? Eat something real, not toast.
Pickles is judging me from the windowsill. Thank you for yesterday. I mean it.
Stop thanking me. That's what sisters-in-law are for. Dan would've done the same for me.
5:30 again tomorrow, same corner as last time?
Same corner. I'll be the one in the oatmeal cardigan.
I'm outside. Don't run, I'm early.
Two minutes. I can't find my glasses anywhere
They're on the chain. Around your neck.
…so they are. Don't say a word.
Stopped at Hinckley for gas. Want a coffee?
Oat milk if they have it. And one of those awful cinnamon rolls ☕
5:30 tomorrow, I'll honk once. Not twice. I have manners.
Once is plenty. Pickles is fed, bag is by the door.
Cal texted me asking if I knew anything about this book club. I said I'd never come between a woman and her paperbacks.
You are a menace. Thank you 😅
Not pushing. Just saying the offer stands. I'll be in the room when you tell him.
I know. Soon. I want to get a few more things in order first.
Picking you up at 5:30 tomorrow. Pack a cardigan, that clinic is an icebox.
Always do. See you at the corner.
I'm outside.
Coming!
Motel's booked for tonight, two queens 👍
You're a saint. I'll pay you back at the next gas station.
Hush. Eat the banana in the glove box before your appointment.
Send me the one of us by the sign 😊
📷 Photo
I look like I'm being arrested. You look lovely though.
Cal called me twice. My phone was in the room. I'll tell him I was wiped out and fell asleep.
Then call him back from the car tomorrow, not tonight. Sound sleepy, it won't be hard.
Checkout's at 11. I'll bring the car round. Stay put and drink your water.
You were quiet today. You ok?
Just finishing something I started. I'm fine, Ruthie.
Random question, and don't take it the wrong way. If anything happens, how do I find the pictures you took?
Hidden album on my phone. The code is the year my boy arrived.
Got it. Nobody will hear it from me unless it's time.
You're a good mother. He'll get there.
I know. Give it a few more weeks. ❤️
Dropped the phone on the kitchen tile. Cal's taking it to get the screen fixed.

Nothing he can't handle. Mostly.
Lorraine.
I know. I know.

msgs.text: Summer inventory starts next week. I'm taking the fiction side, anyone want nonfiction?
I'll take nonfiction. As long as the AC is on.
AC is a 'maybe'. Facilities says Thursday. Facilities has said Thursday since April.
I can bring a fan from the IT closet. It's loud but it works.
Greg, you are a hero.
I wouldn't go that far. The fan has a rattle.
Barcode scanner #2 is dead again. Anyone have a spare battery?
Check the drawer under the circulation desk. Blue sticky note says 'good batteries'.
Found them. Whoever labeled that drawer, I love you.
That was me. You're welcome.
Reminder: all Chromebook carts need to be returned to the media closet by the end of the month. Please wipe them down.
Does 'wipe them down' include the one with the grape juice incident?
Especially that one.
Retirement cake for Mr. Dahl is on. Contribute to the envelope in the front office if you want to chip in.
I'll drop something in tomorrow.
Does anyone know if the new fall schedule has been posted? Mine still shows last year.
Posted on the shared drive, folder called 'FA schedules FINAL v2'.
Of course there's a v2. Is there a v3?
There's a v3 in draft. Don't open it.
Lorraine, are you in the building next week? I need the key to the rare book cabinet.
Spare is in the top drawer of my desk, behind the stapler. I'll be out for some appointments but back soon.
Got it. Thanks!
Pizza Luce for the staff lunch on the first day back? I'll collect orders.
Veggie for me please. No olives.
Anything with pepperoni. Always.
Marcy, you in?
Margherita. Don't judge.
Never. Ordering for 12 then.
IT reminder: password resets are required before school starts. You'll get an email, please don't ignore it. Last year Marcy locked herself out for a week.
It was four days and I was on vacation.
Four days of me having to answer your emails from the beach.
I'll do mine tonight. Thanks for the heads up, Greg.
New carpet in the library is scheduled for the week before school. Everything on the floor needs to be lifted. Please start planning.
All the shelves?
Everything that touches the floor. I'll draw up a map.
Good morning dear!! Just learning this WhatsApp thing from my neighbor. Can you see this message? 🙏
Hi Aunt Carol! Yes, I can see it. You're doing great.
WONDERFUL. How are you sweetheart? How is Callum?
We're both well. He's working a lot. I'm getting ready for summer.
Good. Tell him to eat a vegetable. Boys forget.
I'll pass it along 😊
My hip is acting up again. The doctor says walking is good but it doesn't FEEL good.
Walking in short bursts helps. Callum would say the same. Do you have the cane?
The cane makes me feel old. I hide it in the closet.
Carol. Take the cane out of the closet.
Fine fine. Bossy like your mother.
Recipe for the rhubarb crisp you asked for: 4 cups rhubarb, 1 cup sugar, oats, butter, a little cinnamon. Bake until the kitchen smells like heaven.
Thank you! I'll make it this week.
Did you make it? Was it good?? 🥧
I did. It was gone in a day. I should have doubled it.
That's the sign of a good crisp. 👍
Pastor's wife says hello. They're doing a hymn sing in the fall and need someone to hold the sheet music. Your kind of job.
Sounds lovely. Send me the date when you hear.
I will. Also did you get my card? I sent it to the old address by mistake and then again to the right one.
Both came! Two cards, double the love. Thank you.
Wonderful. I worry about you alone in that house, dear.
I'm alright, Carol. I have the neighbors and my friends. Really.
I know. Dan would be proud of how you've managed.
Thank you. That means a lot.
Pictures of my tomatoes! The biggest one looks like a face. 🍅
The picture didn't come through, Carol. But I believe you. Tomatoes have a lot of personality.
Oh bother. This phone. I'll try again later.
Thinking of you today. Praying for you and Callum. 🙏
That's sweet. Thank you, Carol. Love you.
Love you more! ❤️
📷 Photo
Pickles has never worked a day in his life and it shows 😂
He's retired. Leave him alone.
Lorraine, can you send that hotdish recipe again? Mine always comes out soggy
Tater tots go on LAST, Mark. Not at the start. One can of cream of mushroom, one of green beans, a pound of beef, and a lot of patience.
That's what I did wrong. Thanks!
Mom's hotdish is the only reason I survived college
It was the only thing you'd eat that didn't come in a box.
Did anyone hear if the Fourth thing at Joanne's sister's is still on? Weather looks iffy.
I'm bringing a pie either way.
I can come for a bit. Have to be at the clinic early the next morning.
Of course you do.
Mom, can I borrow the big cooler?
It's in the garage behind the lawn chairs. Mind the spiders.
Great. Spiders are a baseline risk I accept.
Baseline risk 😂 Listen to him.
Pie was a hit. Joanne's sister has asked for a second slice twice.
Glad it went over well. Thanks for having us.
Thanks for having me. I fell asleep in the lawn chair and nobody woke me up.
You looked peaceful. We took a photo for blackmail.
Delete it.
No.
Anyone want to do a lake day soon? Weather's supposed to be perfect.
I'm in. Jenna's got a cooler the size of a car
Can't this time, I've got a thing. Save me a spot at the next one?
A thing. Book club again? 🙄
The club is very demanding.
Anyone want to do a cabin weekend in August? Mille Lacs, the lake should be warm by then.
I'd have to check my schedule. Calendar's a mess.
I can maybe do one day. Depends on the clinic.
One day is better than none. We'll make it work.
Mom, did the plumber come for the kitchen sink?
Walt came by. It was a loose connection under the sink. Forty dollars and a lecture about cheap fittings.
Cheap at twice the price. Dad would've spent a weekend on it.
And made it worse. 😄
Stop, I'm laughing at a stoplight.
Church rummage sale needs volunteers in the fall. I volunteered Mom. Sorry, Mom.
I already said yes. Spreadsheet and label maker, I'm ready.
Of course you are.
📷 Photo
Look at that. Tots on last. I'm proud of you, Mark ❤️
Okay that actually looks amazing
Thinking of Dan today. Six years already.
Me too. I miss him every day.
Yeah. Me too, Mom. Love you both.
Love you both ❤️
Reminder: family dinner at Mom's soon. Bring something, don't just bring yourselves.
I'll bring pie. Store-bought and I will not apologize.
Lorraine! Are we still on for the morning walk around Lake Harriet? The weather's supposed to be perfect.
Yes! Meet at the bandshell at eight?
Eight it is. I'll bring the good coffee.
That was the best walk we've had all year. Rabbit sighting count: four.
I counted three. One of them might have been a squirrel with ambition.
Ha! Anyway, I started that Louise Penny you recommended. I'm hooked.
Wait until you get to the third one. You'll lose a weekend.
I've already lost three nights. My husband says I'm ignoring him.
Read faster, then he'll have you back sooner.
My hydrangeas are finally blooming. Blue this year! I added coffee grounds like you said.
Told you. Dan used to swear by rusty nails in the soil but I never believed it.
I'll stick with the coffee. 😄
Question for you. I'm trying to sort out Medicare supplement forms and I'm drowning. Do you remember which office you went to?
There's a counselor at the Hennepin County senior center, free and very patient. Ask for Ms. Aberg.
Perfect, thank you. You always know who to call.
Went to see Ms. Aberg. Total lifesaver. Lunch on me at Birchwood Cafe?
Gladly. I'll check my schedule.
My granddaughter's visiting from Madison. She wants to see 'a real library with a real librarian'. Can I bring her by?
Of course! I'll show her the rare book cabinet. Ten-year-olds love old things.
She's nine and has strong opinions about fantasy. Fair warning.
Then we'll get along.
She hasn't stopped talking about you. She wants to be a librarian now. Thank you!!
That made my week. Tell her the door's always open.
Walk tomorrow? You've missed the last two.
I know, I'm sorry. Things have been piling up. Next time for sure.
No apologies. Just come when you can. I miss my walking partner.
Me too. Soon.
Saw a flyer for a used book sale at the church this fall. Thought of you.
Mark mentioned it. I think I've been volunteered.
Ha! Then I'll see you there with a wheelbarrow.
Hi Lorraine, this is CVS Pharmacy on Lake Street. Your prescription for lisinopril is ready for pickup. Reply 1 to confirm pickup or 2 to request delivery.
Thanks! We'll hold it at the pharmacy counter for 7 days.
Reminder: your atorvastatin refill is due in 3 days. Reply YES to start the refill.
YES
Got it. We'll text you when it's ready.
Can I pick that up together with the lisinopril on my way home?
Absolutely. Both will be bagged together at the counter. We're open until 9 PM tonight.
Hi Lorraine, you're eligible for your second Shingrix dose. Walk-ins welcome, or book online.
How long do I have for the second dose?
Between 2 and 6 months after the first dose, so you're in the window. No appointment needed.
Your prescription for lisinopril is ready for pickup.
Thank you, I'll stop by tomorrow
Sounds good! Please bring a photo ID.
Shear Joy Salon: Hi Lorraine! You're due for a trim and color touch-up. Want us to find a time? Reply with a day that works.
Hi! Yes. Something in the late afternoon if possible, I work until 3:30.
We have 4:15 with Marta next Thursday. Cut and root color, about two hours.
Perfect, book it.
Confirmed! Reminder: please arrive 10 minutes early. Reply C to confirm or R to reschedule.
C

Thank you both. The color came out lovely.

Hi, can I get a trim sometime in the second half of August? Just the ends, no color.
Of course! Marta has 4:00 on the 20th or 4:30 on the 21st. Which do you prefer?
The 21st, please. And thank you for the teacher discount!
Lorraine, Joanne and I are opening up the cabin on Mille Lacs this weekend. Dan's old rod is still in the rafters. You want it?
Oh Mark. Yes. Hang onto it for me, I'll come get it when the weather's good.
Will do. You should come up and actually use it. He'd haunt me otherwise.
He'd haunt you anyway 😄
True. Fair point.
Saw the guttering on your side is sagging again when I dropped off the ladder. Want me to come fix it?
Would you? I keep meaning to call somebody. Dave's Lawn & Snow doesn't do gutters.
I'll bring screws and a thermos. Give me a couple weeks, Joanne's got me painting the porch.
Take your time. Coffee's on me.
Gutter's done. Your downspout was held on by hope and one rusty nail.
Thank you!! I owe you a lasagna.
Not turning that down.
Heads up, Joanne's sister is hosting the Fourth at her place in Edina. Burgers around two. You in?
I'll bring a pie. Is Cal coming?
Said he'd try. He's working too much. That boy needs a vacation.
He gets that from his father.
Ha. Guilty on Dan's behalf.
Great pie. Joanne wants the recipe. Says it's the crust.
Tell her it's cold butter and not being afraid of it. I'll write it out.
Photo of the walleye I just pulled out of the lake. Eating well tonight
I can't see a photo, it just says it didn't download. But I'll take your word for it 😂
Ha. Phone's acting up. It was a good one though. Like this big.
I'll believe it when I see it.
Is it alright if I give the church office your number? They're organizing a fall rummage sale and want volunteers with a sense of order.
A librarian who sorts books for fun? Sure, go ahead.
Perfect. They'll be thrilled.
You doing ok? Haven't heard from you much lately. Joanne says you've been on the road.
I'm fine, just busy. Summer is the only time I get to see friends. Dinner soon, I promise.
Holding you to that. Love you, sister.
Love you too ❤️
Lorraine, my tomatoes are out of control. Want some?
Yes please! I'll trade you for zucchini bread.
Deal. Leaving a bag on your porch.
Got them. These are huge! Thank you.
Hi Rosa, I'll be away overnight again. Could you look in on Pickles in the morning? Key's under the blue pot.
Of course, mija. He's my favorite neighbor anyway.
Fed him and cleaned the box. He sat on my lap for twenty minutes, shameless 😹
You're an angel. I'll bring tomatoes from the garden.
Can you keep an eye on my house the next couple of days? Going to my sister's.
Of course. Want me to water the ferns?
Yes please, the key's under the blue pot. You're a gem.
Ferns are happy and the mail's on your counter.
Thank you!! Back tomorrow. I'll bring you some of my sister's tamales.
Did you hear that racket last night? Somebody's fireworks.
I slept through it, lucky me. My hearing aids were in the drawer. Oh wait, I don't have those yet.
Ha! Dry humor, I like it.
Tom Halvorsen's tree branch is hanging over our fence again. Should I say something?
I'd bring him a tomato and then mention the branch.
Diplomacy! Genius.
It worked. He's trimming it today. And he gave me a jar of honey.
Honey for tomatoes. That's a good trade.
I'll share. Come by for tea soon.
Same again tomorrow morning? I can come by at 7.
Please. Thank you, Rosa. I owe you a very large pie.

gmail.body:
Cal,

If you're reading this, you found out, or I finally told you. I'm sorry it went this way. I wanted to tell you myself and I kept not doing it. Every time I tried, you were so busy and so happy, and I couldn't make myself be the reason that stopped.

Here's the short version. I have early-onset Alzheimer's. I was diagnosed at the end of April. Dr. Lund is not a boyfriend, Cal. He's my neurologist, and I'm in a trial at his clinic. Ruth has driven me home every time, and she's known from the start. Please don't be angry with her. I made her promise.

The heart next to his name was on purpose. I wanted you cross with me before you were scared for me. I know that was unfair. It's also very much me.

I've been writing you letters, for the days I might not get to say it out loud. The letters are at the credit union. I'm only asking you for one thing. When Dr. Lund or Ruth says it's time, take my car keys. Don't let me talk you out of it. I will try. I'm stubborn. You got that from me.

You were the best thing I ever did. Nothing in my head changes that.

Love,
Mom

notes.body:
Participant ID N4-0317. Bring ID card and the water bottle.

notes.title: Little things
notes.body:
Things I want to keep hold of. Writing them down so they're real.

March 29: Drove home from school and missed my turn on Excelsior. Sat at the light feeling stupid. Then couldn't think of the name of the quiet boy who comes in every day at lunch. Eighth grade. Red backpack. I've known him two years.

April 30: Now it has a name. Early-onset. Sixty-one. Don't write more about it tonight.

May 13: Dr. Lund's office called, and then he called himself. Kind voice. Saved Dr. Lund as Hal ❤. If Cal ever snoops, let him think boyfriend before he thinks disease. Cal can be mad at me about a man. He can't be mad at me about this yet.

Can't do night driving anymore. Ruth drives.

Where I parked: Duluth, ramp behind the clinic, level 3 by the elevator. Write it down EVERY time.

Pickles gets half a can at night, not a whole one.

Dan's watch is in the blue dish by the sink. Tell Cal where it is.

notes.body:
- Is it normal to lose words in the afternoon more than the morning?

notes.title: Lake Harriet walk
notes.body:
Route I like: park by the bandshell, walk the loop (about 2.7 miles), stop at the rose garden if it's in bloom.

Good in early morning, before the bikes. Herons near the north end.

In fall go for the colors along the Minnehaha Creek side. Bring a jacket, it's always colder by the water.

Bandshell concerts on summer evenings. Mark when the schedule comes out.

notes.title: Yoga - Minnehaha
notes.body:
Gentle yoga, Thursday evenings at the studio. First class free, then a monthly pass.

Bring: mat, water, the good towel.

Things the teacher said:
- hips tighten when you sit all day
- breathe out longer than you breathe in
- it's fine to skip the headstand (thank goodness)

Try to go twice a month at least. Janice wants to come along if her knee is better.

notes.title: Wild rice soup
notes.body:
Wendy's recipe, she swears by it.

- 1 cup wild rice, cooked ahead
- 1 onion, diced
- 2 carrots, 2 celery stalks
- 8 oz mushrooms
- 4 cups chicken broth
- 1 cup half and half
- 3 tbsp flour
- thyme, black pepper, a splash of sherry

Sauté veg in butter, stir in flour, add broth slowly. Simmer 20 min. Add rice and cream at the end, don't boil after that.

Cal liked it last winter. Make a double batch and freeze half in the quart containers.

- whether the night guard is worth it
- does insurance cover the crown or only part

Next cleaning in six months. They'll text a reminder.
